description: Machines are real processes, not magic boxes. Each one models a named industrial/chemical process with realistic inputs, outputs, by-products and energy.

description.en: First step of beneficiation: size reduction to liberate mineral grains for concentration.
description.ru: Первый этап обогащения: измельчение для высвобождения зёрен минерала перед концентрацией.

realWorld.basis: Comminution (crushing + grinding) is the most energy-hungry step of mineral processing.

recipe.note: Generic: every ore passes through crushing before concentration.

description.en: Digests bauxite in hot sodium hydroxide to dissolve alumina, leaving red mud behind.
description.ru: Обрабатывает боксит горячим раствором едкого натра, растворяя глинозём и оставляя красный шлам.

realWorld.basis: Bayer process: NaOH digestion at ~150-250 C, precipitation of Al(OH)3, then calcination to Al2O3.

recipe.note: Red mud is hazardous waste; handling it is part of the hardcore loop.

description.en: Electrolyses alumina dissolved in molten cryolite into aluminium metal. Huge continuous DC current.
description.ru: Электролизом разлагает глинозём, растворённый в расплавленном криолите, до металлического алюминия. Огромный постоянный ток.

realWorld.basis: Hall-Heroult: molten cryolite bath ~950-980 C, 4-5 V, ~13-15 kWh per kg Al. Carbon anodes are consumed to CO2.

recipe.note: The energy cost is the balancing lever: aluminium is cheap only at industrial scale.

description.en: Reduces TiCl4 vapour with molten magnesium under argon to make titanium sponge. Batch process, expensive.
description.ru: Восстанавливает пары TiCl4 расплавленным магнием в атмосфере аргона, давая титановую губку. Периодический и дорогой процесс.

realWorld.basis: Kroll process: carbochlorination of ilmenite -> TiCl4, then Mg reduction ~800-1000 C under argon, then vacuum distillation.

recipe.note: Batch + argon + magnesium recycle loop explains titanium's high price.

description.en: Splits water into hydrogen and oxygen. Core of life support (O2) and ISRU fuel production.
description.ru: Разлагает воду на водород и кислород. Основа жизнеобеспечения (O2) и ISRU-производства топлива.

realWorld.basis: 2 H2O -> 2 H2 + O2. Real efficiency ~50-70%; electrolysis is also how ISS can generate O2 (via water from the Sabatier loop).

recipe.note: Produces both propellants and breathing oxygen depending on the need.

description.en: Recycles CO2 into methane and water. Core of closed-loop life support and Martian ISRU fuel production.
description.ru: Перерабатывает CO2 в метан и воду. Основа замкнутого жизнеобеспечения и марсианского ISRU-производства топлива.

realWorld.basis: Sabatier reaction: CO2 + 4 H2 -> CH4 + 2 H2O over a nickel catalyst at ~300-400 C. Used on the ISS (ECLSS).

recipe.note: Methane is liquefied downstream; water feeds the electrolyzer to close the loop.

description.en: Reduces iron ore to pig iron with coke and limestone, then a basic oxygen furnace decarburises it into steel.
description.ru: Восстанавливает железную руду до чугуна коксом и известняком; затем кислородный конвертер обезуглероживает чугун в сталь.

realWorld.basis: Blast furnace ~1600 C: Fe2O3 + 3 CO -> 2 Fe + 3 CO2. Steel = pig iron with carbon removed in the basic oxygen furnace.

recipe.note: Pig iron then goes to the basic oxygen furnace to become steel.

description.en: Extracts oxygen (and metals) directly from regolith by molten-salt electrolysis. Key ISRU technology.
description.ru: Извлекает кислород (и металлы) прямо из реголита электролизом расплавленных солей. Ключевая технология ISRU.

realWorld.basis: Fray-Farthing-Chen (FFC) process reduces metal oxides in molten CaCl2, releasing oxygen. Demonstrated on lunar regolith simulants.

recipe.note: Oxygen is ~42% of lunar regolith by mass - the single biggest ISRU win.
